originalTitle: PEAK: The Final Ascent | Teaser Trailer
content: It's almost here. The final ascent. August 11 PST. We’ve been hard at work crafting PEAK’s final Major Update, and we're finally ready to drop it to the shore near you. Ok well, I guess near a peak...near you. Whatever ANYWAY This update comes with new variant biomes: GLOOM and THE CITADEL, which will cycle out with CALDERA and THE KILN! There's also a new secret for you to discover, but for now... See you in the gloom... Scoutmaster Myres VA: Xalavier Nelson Jr. from @StrangeScaffold !!
